units.title: Set up and structure the cockpit
units.progress: Phase 4 opened: the commander's out-ideas explored by T010 and settled in Ds006 (identifier set ruled Or046 to Or049; stage A reference checker first, then the identifier pass, then a refactor team for the schema store, manifests, frontmatter and rooms). Rq013 (build stage A outside the cockpit) and Rq012 (guard) await the commander, with nine decisions in Ds006. Still open from phase 3: the pilot's agent body, the mission cut and doctrine briefing approvals.

units.title: Make the cockpit self-sustaining and self-improving
units.progress: Horizon. Promoted from Sp009 on the commander's word; goal, definition of done and objectives written; begins when the commander makes it current.
